scope: One fresh acceptance pass for OAuth setup and approval guidance, plus manual review of cited official sources.

cases.useCase: A web app reads titles and content of pages each customer explicitly shares with the integration. Read only. Never create or modify pages or administer the workspace.
A web app lists file and folder names inside each customer's Dropbox App Folder. Metadata only. Never download or change files or use team administration.
A web app reads the connected person's Calendly event types and shows their names. Customer accounts authorize individually. Never create bookings, change event types, or administer the organization.
